summary: One page of a search's people landed in its campaign: what the page held, whom it made members, and whom it made contacts of the directory; one line per page that carried anybody.

key.description: The work item whose answer carried the page: a read of the search, or the search itself where it finished inside its call. One line per page.

audience.description: The audience the search ran under.

plugin.description: The plugin that answered the page, whose identifiers the people were pinned by.

state.description: What the provider said of the search with the page.

people.description: The people the page held, each once.

landed.description: Those the page made members of the campaign.

created.description: Of those landed, the people the page also made contacts of the directory.

already_member.description: People the campaign already held, who stay as they were.

skipped.description: People left out: removed from this campaign, or archived in the directory.

contact_ids.description: The people landed, in the page's order; empty when nobody was.

created_contact_ids.description: Those of the people landed that the page also made contacts of the directory.
